basics.type: Private university under Uttarakhand Act No. 12 of 2011, run by the Graphic Era Educational Society
basics.ugc: Recognised under Section 2(f) of the UGC Act, 1956
basics.campus: Three campuses: Dehradun (Bell Road, Clement Town), Bhimtal (Sat Tal Road, Nainital) and Haldwani (Bareilly Road)
basics.other: AICTE-approved technical programmes; CSE, ME and ECE at Bhimtal accredited by NBA. Graphic Era Hill University is separate from Graphic Era (Deemed to be University)

admission: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics
Merit in Class 12 (PCM), JEE Main percentile or CUET score; GECET is needed for some technical courses
Most other UG and PG programmes
Class 12 or graduation, as per course
Merit in the qualifying exam; GECET for scholarships

scholarships.text: Merit scholarships for the whole course, based on Class 12 marks, JEE Main percentile or CUET score (for B.Tech CSE at Dehradun, ₹6,000 to ₹45,000 per semester). GECET can give up to 100% tuition waiver. Girls get 10% extra, hill-state domiciles a 25% concession and defence wards 5%.

hostel.text: Student accommodation on the Dehradun and Bhimtal campuses.

fees.text: For the 2026 intake, first-year tuition for B.Tech CSE is ₹2,03,700 per semester at Dehradun for all-India students (₹1,52,775 for Uttarakhand students) and ₹1,27,100 per semester at Bhimtal, before scholarships. Each campus and course has its own fee sheet.
